necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. This service addresses the clinical need to evaluate the etiology of the dizziness (R42) and rule out life-threatening arrhythmias associated with the valvular disease.
